conbody.p: MkDocs is a Python-based SSG specifically for project documentation. It is designed to be simple and uses a single YAML config (mkdocs.yml) at the project root. The docs content is written in Markdown files under a docs/ directory. By default, MkDocs has no front matter in each page – all configuration (site name, theme, navigation) lives in mkdocs.yml.
